snippet.title: Babbling Brook - Demo & Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Sculpt sand to create winding streams through lush forests and rolling meadows. Babbling Brook is a relaxing indie game about messing around with water and sand.
Also, there's a flock of rubber ducks trying to escape to the open sea...

Play the demo and wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672300/Babbling_Brook
